category_title: Students who use physical presence and threats to intimidate faculty
scenario_title: Hostile confrontation over a graded assignment
minimal_context: The student is receiving a graded assignment from the professor in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your graded assignment. Please take a look at your score.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rolls eyes and slams textbook on the desk) Just give it here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please review the feedback I wrote on the pages.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the grade, physically displaying frustration and anger) Are you kidding me with this?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you have questions, we can go over them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Waives the graded paper in the professor's face) No, we need to talk about it [the grade] now!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your graded assignment. Please take a look at your score.

STUDENT: (Rolls eyes and slams textbook on the desk) Just give it here.

STUDENT: (Waives the graded paper in the professor's face) No, we need to talk about it [the grade] now!
